title: SmartAgri UGM and Pertamina Patra Niaga Maos Inaugurate Sprinkler Irrigation System Through CSR Partnership
excerpt: SmartAgri UGM and Pertamina Patra Niaga Maos officially inaugurated a sprinkler irrigation system as part of a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) program, bringing research-based precision irrigation technology directly to farming communities. The initiative reflects SmartAgri's commitment to translating campus innovation into tangible on-the-ground impact for sustainable agricultural development.
